description: Coherent public-domain prose haystack corpus for llama/bakeoff/longcontext.py (plans/longcontext-pow2-overnight-campaign.md WP-3, extending plans/quant-sweep-harness-and-instrument-v2.md WP-3's original 5-book v1 corpus). Replaces the uniform-random word-soup haystack (run_harness.py:_build_filler_text, retained as a timing-only fixture) for every correctness-scored long-context trial. v1 (5 books, ~2.72M chars, corpus_id gutenberg-longcontext-haystack-v1) is preserved byte-for-byte in manifest-v1.json so records produced under it stay reproducible; v2 adds 7 more books (~5.36M chars) so a 512k-token-equivalent haystack consumes <35% of the corpus and per-book start offsets stay genuinely randomized across seeds (plan audit M1).
